title: 生命科学
subtitle: Bioscience
keywords: History of life science 2.Biological evolution 3.Biological engineering 4.Biotechnology 5.Green innovation
educationalGoal: It is highly expected that life sciences may provide a novel driving force for the development of Japanese industry in this century. However, biological technologies are still developing, and often encounter unexpected difficulties in their development. This course will review a range of topics in life sciences, introduce the cutting edge of biological engineering and technologies, and cultivate understanding of the interrelationship between life sciences and human societies.
advice: The lectures in this course are designed for students having knowledge learned in the first and second grade courses including “Basic Biology”, “Structure and Function in Physiology”, “Structure and Function of the Cell”, “Molecular Biology”, “Neuroscience” and “Sensory Information”.
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge of basic biology, cell biology and molecular biology.

activityGoals.body: Ability to explain the history of life sciences
Ability to explain the mechanism for biological evolution
Ability to explain information flows in the cell
Ability to explain the interrelationship between life science and human society

achievementLevels.ideal: Be able to explain milestones in life sciences and their significance. Be able to explain detailed mechanisms for biological evolution. Be able to explain systematically the flows of genomic and environmental information in the cell. Be able to explain contributions of life science to human society and their issue. Be able to explain biotechnologies and their underlying principles that contribute to green innovation.
achievementLevels.standard: Be able to explain briefly milestones in life sciences. Be able to explain basic mechanisms for biological evolution. Be able to explain the basics of the flows of genomic and environmental information in the cell. Be able to explain briefly contributions of life science to human society. Be able to explain briefly biotechnologies contributing to green innovation.

lessons.assignments: Preview: Summarize characteristics of life. Review: Review the lecture.
Preview: Summarize 5-10 milestones in life sciences. Review: Review the lecture.

lessons.content: Biological evolution I: Theory of evolution
lessons.assignments: Preview: Summarize the basics of the use-and-disuse theory and the natural selection theory. Review: Review the lecture.

lessons.content: Biological evolution II: DNA for evolution
lessons.assignments: Preview: Summarize factors causing mutagenesis in DNA. Review: Review the lecture.

lessons.content: Biological evolution III: Evolution of multicellularity
lessons.assignments: Preview: Summarize the difference between Chlamydomonas and Volvox. Review: Review the lecture.

lessons.content: Information flow in the cell I: From the gene to the protein
lessons.assignments: Preview: Summarize transcription and translation. Review: Review the lecture.

lessons.content: Information flow in the cell II: Signal transduction
lessons.assignments: Preview: Exemplify a signal transduction pathway from the extracellular input to gene transcription. Review: Review the lecture.

lessons.content: Information flow in the cell III: Mutagenesis to cancer
lessons.assignments: Preview: Summarize mutagenesis causing cancers. Review: Review the lecture.

lessons.content: Information flow in the cell IV: How cells use mechanical information?
lessons.assignments: Preview: Exemplify mechanical stimuli to cells in the body. Review: Review the lecture.

lessons.content: Interrelationship between life science and human society I: Biodiversity
lessons.assignments: Preview: What is inbreeding depression? Review: Review the lecture.

lessons.content: Interrelationship between life science and human society II: Secondary nature
lessons.assignments: Preview: Summarize features of village forests. Review: Review the lecture.

lessons.content: Green innovation I: Biogeochemical cycles and human activities
lessons.assignments: Preview: Summarize roles of carbon, nitrogen and phosphorus in the biological body. Review: Review the lecture.
Preview: Summarize causes and effects of global warming. Review: Review the lecture.
